add_clang_library(dxcompiler STATIC ${SOURCES})
# Static LLVM targets expose some dependencies only to their final consumer.
# Build these real implementations as part of our private closure as well.
llvm_map_components_to_libnames(xl_dxc_components ${LLVM_LINK_COMPONENTS})
add_dependencies(dxcompiler ${xl_dxc_components})
# Enumerate only the static runtime link graph, excluding host tools such as TableGen.
function(xl_dxc_collect target)
  get_property(visited GLOBAL PROPERTY XL_DXC_VISITED)
  if("${target}" IN_LIST visited OR NOT TARGET "${target}")
    return()
  endif()
  set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY XL_DXC_VISITED "${target}")
  get_target_property(kind "${target}" TYPE)
  if(kind STREQUAL "STATIC_LIBRARY")
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY XL_DXC_RUNTIME_TARGETS "${target}")
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY XL_DXC_RUNTIME_FILES "$<TARGET_FILE:${target}>")
  endif()
  foreach(property LINK_LIBRARIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
    get_target_property(entries "${target}" "${property}")
    foreach(entry ${entries})
      string(REGEX REPLACE "^\\$<LINK_ONLY:([^>]+)>$" "\\1" entry "${entry}")
      if(TARGET "${entry}")
        xl_dxc_collect("${entry}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endforeach()
endfunction()
function(xl_dxc_finalize_closure)
  xl_dxc_collect(dxcompiler)
  get_property(files GLOBAL PROPERTY XL_DXC_RUNTIME_FILES)
  get_property(targets GLOBAL PROPERTY XL_DXC_RUNTIME_TARGETS)
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xl-runtime-libraries.txt" CONTENT "$<JOIN:${files},\n>\n")
  add_custom_target(xl_dxc_static DEPENDS ${targets})
endfunction()
cmake_language(DEFER DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" CALL xl_dxc_finalize_closure)

# XLWebEngineUI: newer Clang diagnostics do not turn upstream warnings into errors.
